name: Chief Executive Officer
description: Leads the enterprise from the Executive Office, setting strategic direction, performance expectations, and culture across all divisions. Holds ultimate accountability to the board for financial results, risk posture, and execution of the company's operating model.

name: Chief Financial Officer
description: Owns the Finance & Investments value stream, directing long-range planning, dividend management, and expense policy governance. Oversees reinsurance accounting, unclaimed property compliance, and accounts payable disbursement, while driving cost reduction programs and delivering variance commentary, segment disclosures, and combined ratio analysis to leadership through the ERP and financial reporting stack.

name: Chief HR Officer
description: Leads the Human Resources & Talent value stream, directing incentive compensation administration, leave management, market pricing, and union contract administration. Oversees pay equity analysis and role integration on the HRIS platform, and supports sales distribution through carrier management, producer performance tracking, and commission dispute resolution.

name: Chief Info Security Officer
description: Owns the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, directing data security management, vulnerability risk prioritization, and patch remediation tracking. Oversees privileged account onboarding, session monitoring, and activity auditing on the IAM platform, enforces container security and hardening standards, and tracks assessment findings to closure through the GRC platform.

name: Chief Information Officer
description: Leads the Technology & Engineering value stream, owning the technology roadmap, enterprise architecture governance, and technology standards. Directs modernization planning and vendor evaluation, builds business cases for platform investment, and drives reusable services and platform guardrails that keep solutions aligned to the reference architecture and lifecycle roadmap.

name: Chief Investment Officer
description: Owns investment management within the Finance & Investments value stream, setting investment policy and directing asset-liability management, security selection, and rebalancing. Oversees trade settlement, portfolio valuation, and custodian management, monitors guideline compliance, and tracks breach remediation while communicating revised policy statements to asset managers.

name: Chief Marketing Officer
description: Leads the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, governing agency and broker relationships and designing the distribution operating model. Directs delegated authority oversight, producer training and pipeline support, and retention and cross-sell analytics, while enforcing marketing governance standards and compliance sign-off on partner materials.

name: Chief Operating Officer
description: Owns the Business Operations value stream, directing policy servicing across withdrawal processing, policy loans, reinstatements, and annuitization administration. Oversees annuity application good-order review, plan installation, and nondiscrimination testing, and ensures regulatory obligations such as Form 5500 filings and BSA/AML documentation are met on the policy administration platform.

name: Chief Product Officer
description: Leads the Product & Delivery value stream, owning the agile delivery framework, release planning, and deployment coordination. Directs business acceptance testing and readiness planning, prioritizes product backlogs against value and roadmap, and drives continuous improvement through post-deployment debriefs, release communications, and coaching of product owners and squads.

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: Owns the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, directing enterprise risk assessment, regulatory change management, and risk-based audit planning. Oversees compliance testing, control deficiency management, and market conduct examination support on the GRC platform, monitors key risk indicators, and tracks corrective actions and control re-testing to closure.

name: Chief Strategy Officer
description: Leads corporate strategy and development from the Executive Office, shaping enterprise strategic direction, growth priorities, and portfolio choices. Guides strategic planning cycles and corporate development activity in partnership with divisional leadership.

name: Chief Technology Officer
description: Oversees engineering direction within the Technology & Engineering value stream, owning solution architecture, technology standards, and platform guardrails. Directs modernization planning and technology vendor evaluation, maintains the technology lifecycle and obsolescence roadmap, and champions reusable services validated against the reference architecture with security and privacy review.

name: Chief Underwriting Officer
description: Owns the Underwriting value stream, setting appetite guidelines and directing underwriting quality assurance and portfolio concentration monitoring. Oversees reinsurance program administration including treaty screening and bordereaux submission, governs policy binding and mid-term endorsements on the policy administration system, and tracks appetite exceptions to committee.
